text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Is that... Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(An overwhelmingly strong, solitary 
existence that no one could ever look down 
on—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Even someone blessed with so much talent 
stays late to practice...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, give me some extra training 
menus.
choice_data_list:
Are you planning to do some voluntary 
training now?

Are you planning to do some voluntary 
training now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. If I don't practice more, there's no 
way I'll ever catch up to the strong ones, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I don't want to be some 
spineless coward who just chases from 
behind forever."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting the condition that she wouldn't 
overdo it, we decided to do some extra 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Someday I'll become like her— no, I'm 
gonna beat her too...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is that... Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. That girl has an interesting way 
of running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fired up with resolve, Narita Taishin 
threw herself into extra training right up 
until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then change that pace. Make it Brian's 
pace, not mine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you don't match the pace of the strong 
ones, you'll never get any stronger 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What's all the commotion... Wait, Taishin? 
What in the world happened?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, Brian, huh? She's—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of running a cramped race just to 
match someone else, I'd rather run how I 
want and leave them in the dust. That 
feels the best, and it makes you 
stronger."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—...Is what she'd probably say. 
Personally, I would also recommend running 
at your own pace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seemed unconvinced for a 
while, but in the end, she reluctantly 
nodded and took a rest.
